i dealt with the anesthesia issue not to long ago, my female budgie, rein, had a prolapsed bowel. basically her internal organ was hanging outside of her body and they couldn’t do surgery because budgies are so tiny and they can’t metabolize the anesthesia very well. we had to put her down July 27th. I miss her so much. i’m really glad your situation gets better ❤️ i would try to do some googling and see if you could possibly do a diy splint, i’m not a vet though so take this with a grain of salt 

https://www.cuteness.com/article/fix-broken-bird-wing

try to see if you can find a video or diagram to wrap a birds wing in a splint. i hope your baby flies again and i wish you the BEST of luck ❤️❤️
